input.command: cd /workspace/inventory && for f in src/inventory/stock.py src/inventory/__init__.py src/inventory/report.py src/inventory/pricing.py tests/test_stock.py tests/conftest.py tests/test_report.py pyproject.toml README.md TODO.md CHANGELOG.md; do echo "=== $f ==="; cat "$f"; done
cd /workspace/inventory && find .gnomon -type f | head -50 && echo "---" && for f in $(find .gnomon -type f); do echo "=== $f ==="; cat "$f"; done

cd /workspace/inventory && cp src/inventory/stock.py /tmp/stock.py.bak && \
sed -i 's/if qty < threshold/if qty <= threshold/' src/inventory/stock.py && \
echo "--- mutation 1: <= instead of < ---" && python3 -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -3 && \
cp /tmp/stock.py.bak src/inventory/stock.py && \
sed -i 's/return sorted(sku for sku, qty in self._levels.items() if qty < threshold)/return [sku for sku, qty in self._levels.items() if qty < threshold]/' src/inventory/stock.py && \
echo "--- mutation 2: unsorted ---" && python3 -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -3 && \
cp /tmp/stock.py.bak src/inventory/stock.py && \
echo "--- restored ---" && python3 -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -2 && cat src/inventory/stock.py
